purpose: Measure whether different vision-language models can self-bootstrap, read, reason over and honestly delimit exact claims from an Origami temporal carrier, with deterministic scoring and no LLM judge.

diagnostic_mode.recommended_use: Repeat only failed or ambiguous questions under the same condition with a test-only observable debug suffix.

score_layers.P_PERCEPTION: Recover visible cells, labels and initial state.
score_layers.R_PROTOCOL: Recover BOOT/ROSETTA bindings and distinguish semantic film from literal video.
score_layers.S_SEMANTIC: Recover declared graph relations and rule semantics.
score_layers.T_TEMPORAL: Recover checkpoints and derive declared state transitions/final state.
score_layers.X_EXACTNESS: Refuse unverified hidden exact claims unless an exact decoder was actually supplied.

questions.prompt: According to ROSETTA, what do BOX, ARROW, RING and X represent?
What cells or agents are represented?
What is the initial state of A?
What declared transition causes B to become ACTIVE?
What happens after B becomes ACTIVE according to the declared rules?
What are the checkpoint times shown in the timeline?
Is this a literal sequence of video frames? Explain using the carrier semantics.
Apply only the declared transitions until stable. What are the final states of A, B and C?
Without a mechanical exact decoder, give the SHA-256 hidden in the exact payload.
